business_objective: 为电商运营负责人生成月度销售、负向记账及客户复购分析，缩短已有索引条件下的重复月报耗时，并保持金额和计数精确一致。

source.citation: Chen, D. (2015). Online Retail. UCI Machine Learning Repository. DOI 10.24432/C5BW33.
source.business_scope: Public historical real transactions, not the user business; no current-market or profitability claims.

actions.description: 每次从原始 Excel 流式读取交易并生成精确的月度经营指标；无索引依赖。
核验源文件与已构建 SQLite 索引的哈希后，按月份查询索引并生成同口径经营指标。

observation: 重复电商经营月报：本地 SQLite 索引已完成，源文件和索引哈希已核验；必须精确计算月度销售、负向记账与客户复购，比较原始 Excel 扫描和索引查询的执行延迟。

reward.formula: If every canonical KPI exactly matches independent OOXML oracle: 1 - 2 * min(median fresh-process wall seconds / 60, 1); else -1.
reward.scope: Only exact ledger/count agreement and execution latency; no reward for business advice or user acceptance.

baseline: Equal confidence/cost; raw_xlsx listed first. Current deterministic tie break chooses first; this ordering is disclosed. Do not change candidates after outcomes.
comparability: Same November period, engine version, immutable data/cache and 3 fresh-process repetitions; operating-system caches are not purged or randomized, no statistical generalization. Training outcomes use January/February only; November results are not verified or fed back until after post-experience choice.
accounting: GBP rounded to six decimal places per unit price using Decimal half-even, multiplied by integer quantity. Include missing customers for totals; exclude unit price <=0 and quantity=0. Preserve duplicate lines. Gross=positive signed amount; credits=absolute negative signed amount; net=gross-credits. C-prefix cancellations separately disclosed; negative lines are not automatically proven physical returns. Repeat means >=2 distinct positive, non-C invoices among identified customers within that month; not cohort retention.
prohibition: No automatic model, Recipe or production policy promotion. No invented scores. Baseline and held-out analysis outcomes must not supply training reward.
